title: High thermal stability and tensile-strength bacterial cellulose–silica–PEO composite solid polymer electrolyte for long-life and dendrite-free lithium metal batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19741-19750
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02218E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hwichan Hong, Seungman Park, Seon Jae Hwang, Minjun Bae, Yonghwan Kim, Won Young An, Yongyeol Park, Dohyeong Kim, Yujin Chang, Yuanzhe Piao
The BC–SiO2@PEO composite electrolyte demonstrates high mechanical strength, thermal stability up to 150 °C, and stable lithium cycling over 700 h, offering a promising pathway toward safe and long-life Li metal batteries.
